comparison.objective: Measure tyre tread depth with a pen gauge and return the gauge to its rest.
comparison.physical_skill: Precisely seat a probe on a groove floor with its foot spanning adjacent ribs, then withdraw without changing the reading.
comparison.success_condition: A valid reading within 0.8 mm of true depth after verified seating, followed by release on the gauge rest.
comparison.reason: This is localized metrology and probe contact, not bimanual load sharing or many-body separation through a screen. No material rubric details are missing.
